name: Hong Kong

supply.note: Hong Kong draws on local catchment, raw water imported from Guangdong under the Dongjiang agreement, and the Tseung Kwan O desalination plant. Shares are withheld under Rule 9.5: no annual production mix with a year attached has been captured.

freshness_note: Water charges have not been revised since 16 February 1995 and the sewage charge since 1 April 2017.
open_items: An annual production mix with a year attached, to publish supply shares under Rule 9.5. Not a blocker for the price.
grade_note: Grade A on the water supply figure. U = 0: nothing in the bill is uncertain. The rates are statutory and unchanged since 1995, the four-month period is defined in the Waterworks Regulations, the billing formula including both of its rounding stages is established from WSD's own two worked examples, and there is no standing charge to assume away.
reconciliation_note: Two independent public checks rather than one private invoice. WSD publishes worked examples at 127 and 117 days for the same 66 m³, and the engine reproduces HK$274.05 and HK$299.51 exactly. The pair is the stronger test: the same volume over a shorter reading period must cost more, and it does.
